falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the primary tracked risk asset prints a daily close more than 10% below the swing low that generated the bottom_2022_may_luna match, on volume above its 20-day average.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The Luna-style capitulation base is wrong; price is in downside continuation, so HOLD/UNKNOWN is invalidated and the call should be risk-off, not a bottom analog.

falsification_conditions.condition: Within 14 days the same asset closes more than 18% above that swing low and reclaims the pre-match breakdown level, while blowoff score rises from 37 to above 65.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The post-crash base/hold read is already late; regime has flipped to an upside impulse, so UNKNOWN/HOLD and the bottom-pattern match are both false.

falsification_conditions.condition: Over the next 14 days, 7-day realized volatility falls below the 30th percentile of the prior 90 days and daily true range stays under 2% on at least 10 of 14 sessions.
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The tape is a low-vol drift, not a May-2022 Luna capitulation base, so the 79% pattern match and the HOLD justified by it are invalidated.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
